NOTE (P3, non-blocking, not grading-relevant): instruction.md:17 says '/assets and /instructions are unavailable at runtime', while task.toml:2 declares artifacts ['/app','/assets'] and test.sh:88 chmods /assets at grade time, so /assets may in fact be present in the verifier. The brief is only stricter than reality: a conforming app that copies the seed into /app works, and an app reading /assets would not be misgraded either way. artifacts and test.sh are template-controlled. I did not verify Harbor's artifact-transfer semantics, so this is recorded as a Note, not a Fail.
Weak/alternative probes: an app that hard-codes port 3000 without reading PORT, or keeps its DB elsewhere, is still launched with PORT=3000 and DB_PATH=/app/app.db, so no drift can misgrade it; a conforming app that follows the hireops_rules.md section 8 env list sees exactly what test.sh injects. No literal the judge checks disagrees with the seed, so a correct seed-loading app cannot be failed by a stale literal.
